items.item_text: High school diploma and two to five year of custodial experience.
Experience in the custodial profession and in assigning work, training and development, and performance counseling.
Supervisory experience including recruitment, training, setting work assignment, setting expectations, evaluating performance, and providing reward or corrective action as required.

Experience operating machines, tools, and equipment used on the job: wet/dry mops; standard/hi-speed floor machines; square buffers; dry foam/wet extractor type carpet shampoo equipment; upright, back-pack and wet/dry vacuum cleaners; mop buckets and wringers; automatic (electric/battery) scrubbers.
Experience reading and interpreting technical, safety and MSDS documentation as it relates to the use of chemicals, equipment, and tools.

Experience in effective oral and interpersonal communication skills to interact with all members of the campus community and staff on a variety of subjects including (but not limited to) work requests, customer service, complaints, and performance, as well as provide written reports and instructions, and develop processes for task assignment and completion. Experience using computers and software applications such as Microsoft Windows, Word and Excel.

Experience independently organizing work to achieve timely progress on multiple simultaneous projects, distribute effort appropriate among the projects, meet deadlines and maintain a high level of productivity.
Experience with customer service skills to follow through on customer requests to resolve problems, answer questions, and use available resources and references.

These positions report to the Senior Custodial Supervisor. Under supervision, oversee employees within an assigned area. Assists the Senior Custodian Supervisor with the following: performs monthly building audits; provides training and/or retraining of staff; oversees special project work; inventories equipment and keys; ensures equipment is properly maintained; assists in supply orders and locker inventory; reviews work orders and performs follow up inspections for completion of work needed; works with senior supervisor on performance issues; writes and conducts performance appraisals; conducts safety and in-field meetings; provides back up coverage for supervisor as well as area coverage. Ensures equipment is properly maintained and custodial inventory is maintained. May assist other supervisors. Performs other assignments as required.
Demonstrated knowledge in the established safety procedures in the use and handling of hazardous materials and toxic waste.
Demonstrated knowledge in cleaning functions and related custodial techniques necessary to care for buildings used for a variety of different purposes on a large campus.
Skill to develop creative solutions to general problems and unfamiliar projects/assignments and respond with flexibility to requests for assistance.
